title: Avomi CLIQ Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill - Grape Ice
description: The Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pods provide a seamless and highly efficient vaping experience when paired with the Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod Kit. Each replacement package includes a standard 2ml prefilled pod alongside a 10ml refill e-liquid container. Both components are loaded with premium Nicotine Salt 20mg e-liquid, ensuring a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction. The replacement pod utilises Avomi's advanced mesh coil technology to maximise flavour intensity and vapour consistency. The innovative auto-refill system allows for mess-free operation. By simply combining the 2ml pod with the 10ml container and sliding them into your Avomi Cliq device, you can enjoy up to 6000 puffs* of reliable MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping. Grape Ice serves up a deeply flavoursome and intensely sweet profile. It captures the rich, dark essence of purple Grape, elevating the fruity depth with a brisk wave of frosty Ice to keep the palate refreshed throughout the day. Once the pod and the 10ml container are completely empty, you can simply dispose of them responsibly and swap them out for a fresh Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod + Refill pack. View the full range of Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod Kits & Refill Pods. *Puff counts are approximate and depend on the length of draw on each use.
